mutations.invariant: IMAGINED evidence can never back a non-IMAGINED (fact) claim.
An agent role (e.g. the interpretation/Ethnographer agent) can only author claims in its permitted epistemic layers -- it can never write an OBSERVED claim.
A BLE peripheral identifier is always transformed through HMAC before persistence -- never stored as (or trivially reversible to) the raw identifier.
A Wi-Fi Mode A observation never carries a raw SSID/BSSID field -- only anonymous aggregate features.

mutations.invariant: When sensor divergence crosses the space-anchor threshold, the anchor is always reported Invalidated -- movement is never silently ignored.
Erasing a source Observation always invalidates every downstream Event/Episode/Pattern/Interpretation derived from it.
Belief can never be recorded for a stream across an unacknowledged sensor outage.
SqliteLedger::verify_chain must never silently accept a corrupted/torn hash on reopen -- a stored event whose hash does not match its recomputed hash must always be reported as a broken chain.
A record past its retention tier's cutoff is always eligible for deletion -- retention never silently extends past the §85 tier.
